title: November 1993, in fragments
subtitle: Architectural daylight treatment · same source and camera
idea: Give the strongest 3D source evidence the atlas's principal visual treatment.
limit: 225,371 original triangles; nominal camera calibration. Heights are relative to a fitted park/road plane, not HKPD. Only 3,780 of 171,307 dense points lie inside the local map-control hull.
caption: The same original mesh in neutral daylight. The artistic treatment changes; the source coordinates, holes and camera do not.
